nodes.label: First-Contribution Architecture Guide
nodes.rationale: A newcomer mental model separates Rundale game content from the Parish shared Rust engine, runtime entry points, desktop/web transports, and Svelte UI, then routes commands, NPC behavior, UI work, endpoints, and content changes to their owning layers.

nodes.label: Shared Semantics and Mode Parity Rule
nodes.rationale: Reusable behavior belongs in the shared core while CLI/headless, Tauri, and web retain transport glue; contributors must assess all modes and use the existing dual-transport UI abstraction.
